s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 chipotle and lime juice. Serve in 12 warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, crema and lime wedges.

Toss 300g peanuts with the zest of 2 limes, 1 tsp chilli powder and flaky salt. Roast at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool and fold into four little foil packets, like the snacks on the flight to Cabo.

m.note: the bail bondsman who falls for Jackie
m.how: Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for an hour. Sear 4 sirloins, pull at 54C and rest. Cut an iceberg into 4 wedges and spoon over 100g blue cheese mixed with sour cream. Load the potatoes with sour cream and chives.

w.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs and vanilla. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and 80g walnuts and bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 55 minutes. Beat 40g soft butter with 1 tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Toast thick slices and spread with the maple butter.

d.how: Simmer 50g sugar, 50ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Squeeze 4 blood oranges and 2 oranges. For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice, add 45ml vodka and 10ml ginger syrup and top with about 150ml of the mixed juice. Stir and add a blood orange wheel.
